name: Renishaw plc
summary: Renishaw plc, an engineering and scientific technology company, designs, manufactures, distributes, sells, and services technological products and services, and analytical instruments and medical devices worldwide. The company operates through three segments: Industrial Metrology, Position Measurement, and Specialised Technologies.
